text: Dora Altbir, born on 21 February 1961, is a Chilean physicist specializing in nanoscience and nanotechnology. She received the National Prize for Exact Sciences (Chile) in 2019 in recognition of her contributions to the theoretical study of magnetic nanostructures. Currently, she serves as a professor at the University of Santiago, Chile, where she also holds the position of director of the Center for the Development of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (CEDENNA) and director of the Dirección de Investigación Científica y Tecnológica (DICYT).
